title: A message is written only inside the caller's transaction
statement: A message MUST be written only inside the caller's transaction, after its payload is checked, and a notice MUST follow the commit and never precede it.

title: One worker holds one message under a lease
statement: A message MUST be claimed by at most one worker at a time under a lease, only the current lease MUST be able to finish it, and a late result MUST NOT count as a success.

title: Delivery is in order per key
statement: Messages MUST be delivered in order within one key, a retry MUST block only its own key and MUST keep the message identity, and an unknown destination MUST stay queued.

title: A database failure is never a delivery
statement: A database failure MUST NOT be counted as a delivery, a lost claim result MUST keep the lease, a failed claim MUST return nothing, and a process crash MUST leave every rule intact.

title: The worker and its subscriptions are bounded
statement: Worker concurrency and subscriptions MUST be bounded by checked limits, a lost session MUST stop every subscription, and shutdown MUST finish a completed delivery and return a cancellation as such.

title: The queue keeps no error text, and dead letters go only on purpose
statement: The queue MUST store no error text or payload copy, the blocked view MUST list each stuck key once, and purge MUST remove dead letters only.

title: Every item reaches its action unchanged, one key at a time
statement: A queued item MUST reach its action with its content unchanged and never merged with another, equal keys MUST run serially while other keys continue, and a change that arrives during a key's action MUST request a later pass.

title: The queue is bounded with backpressure
statement: Worker count, key capacity and reconnect delay MUST be refused outside their bounds, and each producer MUST hold at most one key waiting for admission.

title: Retries are off by default, bounded, and retry only the action
statement: The zero retry policy MUST make one attempt, a policy MUST be refused beyond four attempts or outside one millisecond to one second of delay, each attempt MUST get a fresh budget, cancellation MUST stop a delay, and a scan, window, checkpoint or denied error MUST NOT be retried.

title: A reconnect keeps the schedule
statement: Across watch sessions the queue MUST keep its keys, their order, due times, capacity and a failed scan's capped backoff, and an interrupted action MUST run again.

title: Scans resume after the last success with opaque cursors
statement: A scan MUST resume from the cursor of the last item whose action succeeded, MUST treat cursors as opaque and refuse an oversized or non-UTF-8 one before any read, and MUST return incomplete progress without error at its page budget.

title: A stream is bounded and closed
statement: A stream MUST have separate open and receive limits, MUST stop with the scan contract error past its item limit, MUST be cancelled and joined when the scan returns, and a value the receive function returns after its receive timeout MUST NOT reach the emitter.

title: Each operation is its own trace with a fixed outcome, and telemetry holds no private value
statement: Each reconciliation, scan and sweep MUST start its own trace root, MUST end with exactly one of success, failure, timeout or cancelled, and no metric, snapshot or exposition MUST carry a key, payload, error text or resource ID.

title: Overlapping controllers share one private provider set, and a failed callback emits one event
statement: Overlapping controllers in one process MUST share one private telemetry provider set that the first starts and the last closes, the monitor MUST bind loopback only, and a callback failure MUST emit exactly one service.failed event with no formatted cause.

title: A retry never outruns its budget
statement: A retry delay MUST be refused when it exceeds the action timeout; a failed attempt MUST be cancelled and its callback joined before the delay starts; no further attempt MUST start when the remaining work budget cannot cover the delay and a full action; a terminal peer failure MUST cancel the pending retries of a parallel cycle; and a later success MUST NOT clear a failure already stored in the cycle checkpoint.

title: Backoff follows its cause
statement: A failed connection attempt MUST NOT delay keys already queued, an interrupted action MUST take the next capped delay rather than a reset one, a successful scan MUST clear the scan backoff, and a queued action MUST be able to run while the next scan waits for its due time.

title: Admission never blocks a producer
statement: The scan cursor MUST advance only after the item is admitted, the page request context MUST end before the scan waits for admission, admission MUST stop on cancellation, and adding a key MUST NOT block the caller.

title: One collector per controller, fixed in size
statement: A collector that another running controller holds MUST be refused; the collector MUST expose a fixed instrument set, queue capacity, queued, active, retrying, waiting and ready, completed actions by outcome, retries, completed scans, reconnects and one fixed duration histogram, with no configurable label and a size that does not grow with the resource count; counters MUST survive a reconnect and gauges MUST reset when the queue stops; and a cancelled action MUST schedule no retry in a stopped queue while an interrupted scan MUST NOT count as completed.

title: The monitor serves metrics on loopback only, within fixed limits
statement: The monitor MUST serve GET /metrics in Prometheus text format with no-store and nosniff, answer 404 to any other path and 405 to any other method, register on no default mux, bind loopback only, and run with header, read, write and idle limits and a 4 KiB header cap; an empty address MUST give a nil collector and no server; a listener failure MUST stop the controller from starting; and when either part exits the monitor MUST close the listener, cancel the shared context and join both.

title: Startup shares one telemetry runtime
statement: The monitor MUST start the telemetry runtime before the application callback and hold it for the callback's whole life, so that setup, nested controllers and deferred cleanup share one runtime and one instance identity; it MUST wait for an ongoing bounded provider close; each queue MUST register once, unregister when its run ends, and be refused beyond sixty-four; cancellation MUST emit no failure event; the callback's value and error identity MUST return unchanged; and a probe command MUST start no telemetry.

title: Each operation logs once, at a severity its outcome sets
statement: Each reconcile, scan and watch MUST emit one completion log and one duration sample that carry the operation, the outcome, the retry flag and the span's trace and span IDs, valid also when unsampled; a watch span MUST cover one session and end before reconnect; the log MUST be INFO for success and cancellation, WARN for a failure that retries and ERROR for one that does not; watch start, reconnect and cleanup-summary failure MUST be fixed events; and the instruments MUST be the fixed stego.controller.* set with no configurable label.

title: A sweep validates first and classifies each failure
statement: A sweep MUST validate every definition before it starts telemetry and MUST start no provider when its context is already cancelled; it MUST register no keyed queue; a pass deadline MUST count as a retry only while the run is active and the error is not terminal; a page callback that returns no error after its deadline MUST be recorded as a timeout and MUST NOT become a source error for the terminal policy; and the sweep MUST join its workers before the next page and before close.

title: Scan progress is exact
statement: On a source or emitter error a resumed scan MUST return the progress of the completed prefix together with the error; it MUST refuse a page above its size bound and bound each page read by the operation timeout; a scan from the beginning MUST return the scan contract error, not partial progress, when its page budget cannot cover the source; and a scan MUST start no background work.

title: Cleanup sampling is its own bounded worker
statement: With metrics enabled the runtime MUST read the cleanup summary on its own worker, under the action timeout and at the resync interval, join it on shutdown, and never read it when metrics are disabled; a failed read MUST keep the last values but mark them unavailable, shutdown MUST mark them unavailable, a malformed sample or a terminal access error MUST stop the controller, any other failure MUST be reported and sampled again, and a failed sample MUST keep its own counter and never count as a work retry.

title: An operation root keeps its context and bounds its span
statement: An operation root MUST keep the supplied context's cancellation, deadline and runtime ownership and change trace ancestry only; a database span MUST be a child of the current operation; sampling MUST apply to each operation root; a controller span or log MUST carry no resource key, provider response, credential or private error text; and attribute and link counts per span MUST stay within the default limits.

title: Without a collector, no provider
statement: When no collector endpoint is set the runtime MUST start no provider and open no connection, and the service MUST serve as if telemetry were absent.

title: Export is bounded, verified and never retried
statement: Export MUST go over one verified HTTPS gRPC connection owned by private providers with no global, each export MUST finish inside its deadline, send at most one MiB and never be retried, and startup MUST NOT wait for the collector.

title: Queues drop rather than block, and failures are counted safely
statement: The trace and log queues MUST be bounded and drop rather than block the request, and each failed export batch MUST be counted per signal and answered with a fixed safe error.

title: One span per request or call, named by the pattern, never the URL
statement: The runtime MUST start one server span per HTTP request and one RPC span covering the whole call, named by the method and the registered route or protobuf method when bounded and _OTHER otherwise, and never by the URL.

title: A failure marks the span without a message
statement: A status of 500 or more, a panic or a failing RPC status MUST mark the span with a fixed error type and MUST NOT attach a message, a cause or a value.

title: Every call is measured and logged once, sampled or not, with no private data
statement: Request duration metrics and one completion log per call MUST exist whether or not the span is sampled, MUST be correlated with the span when it is, and MUST hold no raw path, resource ID, body, credential or user detail.

title: The server span starts before authentication and ends with the transport status
statement: The HTTP and RPC server span MUST start before authentication and capacity admission and end only after the final status is known, MUST NOT change authentication, capacity reservation, stream identity expiry, I/O deadlines or shutdown of the observed call, and the public health and discovery routes MUST stay outside the request span, metric and log wrappers.

title: A valid parent continues the trace, and the remote flag never decides sampling
statement: A single valid traceparent MUST continue its trace ID and parent ID, and the remote sampled flag MUST NOT change the local ratio decision at any ratio.

title: Settings have fixed defaults and a fixed shape
statement: With a collector endpoint and no exporter setting, traces, metrics and request logs MUST be enabled; the sampling ratio MUST default to 0.1, the metric export interval to ten seconds and the service name to the declared service name; the protocol setting MUST be absent or grpc; and the certificate setting MUST be read only as a bounded regular PEM file, with the system roots when it is absent.

title: Export limits are fixed numbers
statement: The trace queue MUST hold at most 256 spans, exported in batches of at most 32; each export MUST end within two seconds with a 64 KiB response limit; and shutdown MUST give the provider at most three seconds.

title: Request metrics have fixed names, units and labels
statement: The runtime MUST emit http.server.request.duration and rpc.server.call.duration as histograms in seconds with fixed boundaries through 1,800 seconds and cumulative temporality, labelled by method, registered route or RPC method, status and a fixed error class; MUST emit http.server.active_requests and rpc.server.active_requests as label-free up-down counters; and MUST NOT use a trace or span ID as a metric label.

title: A completion log has a fixed name and a severity its outcome sets
statement: The completion log MUST be named http.server.request.completed or rpc.server.call.completed, MUST carry the span's fields, the duration and the trace and span IDs, and MUST be INFO for a normal completion, WARN for a denied or failed client request and ERROR for a server failure.

title: The RPC span records a fixed attribute set
statement: The RPC server span MUST record exactly rpc.system.name, rpc.method and rpc.response.status_code with one of the seventeen gRPC status names; only UNKNOWN, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, UNIMPLEMENTED, INTERNAL, UNAVAILABLE and DATA_LOSS MUST mark it failed, with error.type equal to that status name; and no server span MUST carry a resource ID, a user identity, a peer address or error text.

title: The route pattern survives a copied request and zero sampling
statement: The span, metric and log MUST carry the registered route pattern also when authentication copies the request and when the sampling ratio is zero, and metrics and logs MUST NOT take their fields from recorded span attributes.
